source: segmentation (Blender simulation with background replaced by white)
pixel_convention: x right, y down, full-resolution pixels (1080x1080)

camera.motion: static (lamp post and hydrant pixel-stable over all 89 frames; median background subtraction leaves no residue on them)
camera.background: uniform white (~253), no ground plane, horizon or vanishing lines visible
camera.perspective_cues: Only ground-contact rows: hydrant base y=892, lamp base y=893, man's feet y~866-873 (he is slightly farther from the camera than the two props, he passes BEHIND both). Lamp post appears vertical (no tilt visible). Man's apparent height constant (~217 px median) -> walks at ~constant depth, roughly parallel to image plane.

man.description: the only person: adult man, dark navy jacket, grey trousers, dark hair, white/blank face; walks left to right
man.reference_point: pelvis estimate: x = head centre + (-4.7 px torso offset), y = head_top + 0.47*222 px

apparent_height_px.note: mask min values <208 (frames 12-14) are feet hidden behind hydrant, ignore

mask_width_px.note: varies with stride (legs apart ~110-116, legs together ~40)

man.occlusion: bbox overlaps hydrant frames 0-57 (legs/lower body hidden mainly frames 0-~40); overlaps lamp post frames 19-20 and 32-88 (torso largely hidden ~55-68); head partly behind lamp shaft frames 49-70 (frames ~59-62 head almost fully hidden)

lamp_post.description: black street lamp with lantern head on a tall thin shaft and a wider base; right of hydrant
lamp_post.note: in front of the man (occludes him)

fire_hydrant.description: white/grey weathered fire hydrant with rust spots and a chain, side nozzle to the right; leftmost object
fire_hydrant.note: in front of the man (occludes his legs early in the clip)

events.event: man already walking at first frame (no start-from-rest)
man's head starts passing behind lamp shaft
man's head centre aligned with lamp shaft (~x 191)
man's head fully clear of lamp shaft on right
man's pelvis_x passes hydrant centre x (101.5 px) (man is behind it)
man's rear foot / body last overlaps hydrant bbox (bbox_x0 <= 140)
man's pelvis_x passes lamp shaft axis x=193 (man is behind it)
man still walking at last frame

direction: man moves monotonically +x (rightwards); no direction changes; vertical position constant apart from gait bob
